title: Birds Aren't Real
description:
About Us!Jox Studio is a newly established game studio based in Canada, focusing on story-driven & narrative games. 
Our next WIP game will be an interactive fiction game, with Steam store page coming soon.About this game:A short story-driven psychological horror game. 
As a lost traveler, find out what happened to the previous owners of this abandoned house.
The story is inspired by the 1994 novel "The Memory Police" by Yoko Ogawa.Features:• Short duration (30-40 minutes).

• Psychological Horror.

• No visual jumpscares. 

• A good story worthy of a read.
description_short: A short story-driven psychological horror game. No visual jumpscares; only mentally disturbing.
